deep_dive.title: LithoGRPO: Fast Inverse Lithography via GRPO Reinforced Flow Matching
deep_dive.abstract: In semiconductor manufacturing, lithography projects circuit layouts onto silicon wafers through an optical mask. As circuit features shrink below the wavelength of light, optical diffraction causes the printed patterns to deviate from their intended layouts. Inverse Lithography Technology (ILT) addresses this challenge by generating optimized masks that enhance the fidelity of pattern transfer onto wafers. While ILT resembles an image synthesis task, its reliance on explicit physical metrics for mask evaluation limits the applicability of existing generative models. We introduce LithoGRPO, an ILT framework that integrates the flow-matching paradigm with GRPO-based reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning, enabling efficient exploration of diverse masks for a given target layout. Unlike purely generative or optimization-based approaches, RL in LithoGRPO exploits the explicitly defined, physics-based reward function of ILT, enabling optimization under complex, process-aware constraints. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first framework that unifies flow matching and RL for mask optimization. To improve RL sampling efficiency, we propose a fast shot-counting algorithm for manufacturability evaluation, achieving over 130x speedup while preserving the mask ranking of the traditional shot-count metric. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LithoGRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance over both optimization-based and learning-based methods, while maintaining efficient mask generation.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Combines flow matching with GRPO reinforcement learning fine-tuning for inverse lithography mask optimization, improving fidelity.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对半导体制造中深亚波长光刻带来的图案失真问题，逆光刻技术通过生成优化掩模来提高保真度。现有生成模型由于依赖显式物理度量而受限。本文提出LithoGRPO，将流匹配生成模型与基于GRPO的强化学习微调相结合，通过奖励驱动探索掩模空间。实验证明，该方法在掩模质量和生成效率上均优于基线，为强化学习在图像生成领域的应用提供了有效案例。
